# Set-ZbxProxyGroup

## SYNOPSIS

Changes a proxy group.

## SYNTAX

```
Set-ZbxProxyGroup [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixProxyGroup>[]> [[-Name] <string>] [-FailoverDelay <string>] [-MinOnline <string>] [-Description <string>] [-AdditionalProperty <Hashtable>] [-Force] [-PassThru] [-PipedRecord <PSObject>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A proxy group shares its hosts among its proxies and moves them to another proxy of the group when one goes offline (Zabbix 7.0 and later). The Set-ZbxProxyGroup cmdlet changes the proxy groups given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped objects) with proxygroup.update; a field whose parameter is not given keeps its value. Every proxy group the pipeline brings is changed in one call when the pipeline ends, and -AdditionalProperty sets any other field by its API name. The command writes nothing unless -PassThru is given, which reads the changed proxy groups back and writes them; -WhatIf shows what would change.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Change a proxy group

```powershell
Set-ZbxProxyGroup -InputObject 'proxy-group-01' -MinOnline '2'
```

Makes the proxy group proxy-group-01 need two proxies online to be online itself.

### Example 2: Change a proxy group and write the result

```powershell
Set-ZbxProxyGroup -InputObject 'proxy-group-01' -MinOnline '2' -PassThru
```

The same change with -PassThru, which reads the proxy group proxy-group-01 back from the server and writes it; without it the command writes nothing.
